title: How does a key open a pin tumbler lock?

shots.title: Hook: the lock
shots.say: Why does only one key turn this lock?

shots.title: Pins block the gap
shots.say: Inside, springs push stacks of pins down across the gap, so the inner cylinder can't turn.

shots.title: Key lifts the pins
shots.say: Slide the key in, and each ridge lifts its pin stack to a different height.

shots.title: Splits line up
shots.say: With the right key, every split between pins lines up exactly at the gap.

shots.title: The cylinder turns
shots.say: Nothing blocks it now, so the cylinder turns and the bolt slides back.

description: Springs, pins and one shear line: a lock cutaway in 3D, the key lifting each pin to its height.
